# IA Usage

Windows desktop app and CLI for monitoring AI usage limits, quota resets,
credits and provider health.

- App: Tauri 2 tray app (`src-tauri/`, GUI in `src/`)
- Core: shared provider pipeline (`crates/iausage-core/`)
- CLI: `iausage` (`crates/iausage-cli/`)
- Stable contract: DashboardSnapshotV1 (`schemaVersion: 1`)

## CLI

```powershell
iausage usage [provider] [--json] [--refresh]
iausage providers [--json]
iausage best [--json]
iausage doctor [provider] [--json]
iausage refresh [--provider ID]
iausage guard --provider claude --window session --min-remaining 15
iausage config validate
iausage version
```

Guard exit codes: 0 enough, 1 below limit, 64 bad args, 69 unavailable.
